_comment: Anchor 1, global process spread. Planned by issue #244; first run 2026-11-15 (see records/20261115-* in ../records/ and README.md 'Status').
Run-step changes from the 2026-10-17 plan draft (all recorded in README.md):
(1) models: per-family section bundles with explicit lib paths (the working post-#79 fleet shape,
elaborate-post79/request-elaborate-post79.json) instead of the never-generated corners_mc_sg13g2.lib aggregator;
the PDK's own sections hbt_typ_stat / mos_tt_stat / cap_typ_stat already exist in cornerHBT/MOShv/CAP.lib,
so the aggregator has nothing left to add.
(2) monte_carlo.seed_scope = "shared": klt 0.8.0+ implements klayout-tools#2899 behind this field; the default
per_corner keys the seed on the point's position, so sample k at Vctrl=0 and at 3.3 V would be different dies
and the paired-endpoint derived rows (band centre, ratio) would be meaningless. shared makes sample k the same
die at every point.
(3) analysis 20 ns / two-WHEN TD=10n estimator: the plan draft's 5 ns tran with a RISE=11->21 TRIG/TARG count cannot
work at this design's frequencies (21 crossings need ~5.8 ns at f_min; the 5 ns grid's estimator errored exactly
this way, record 20261105-180000-f6c364b). The two-WHEN TD=10n form is the one the elaborate-post79 record
validated; its TRIG/TARG+TD alternative is recorded there as defective (TD applies to one clause only).
(4) osdi_preload: the OSDI varactor is how the fleet loads sg13_hv_svaricap (#290/#291 route).
Seed 244 was fixed before any run and is not to be tuned. N=400 and the analysis limits are argued in README.md,
'Sample size'. Derived rows (f0 band centre, tuning ratio, swing = vdiff_max - vdiff_min) are assembled per sample
from the paired Vctrl points into a klt yield sample-set document by the run step (README.md, 'Analysis').
Anchor: PDK statistical centre at 27 C, nominal 3.3 V rail (mos_tt_stat's *_norm centres are the PDK's own stat
centre, not all 1.0). Vctrl axis is the two tuning endpoints (rows 1, 2); mid-window and supply-pushing points are
later stages (README.md, 'Stages'). Global statistical sections only: no *_mismatch section is loaded, so every
per-instance agauss() is absent, not merely variance-0.
keep_artifacts false: the report carries every per-sample measurement; 800 per-unit artifact trees would be dead
weight (the seed control, the harness check, keeps its artifacts).
engine_version 47 is a fail-closed pin (issue #3041): the fleet runner image carries ngspice-47 since
~2026-11-13; ngspice-46 aborts nothing here but 47 WITHOUT the selft=0 overlay NaNs at the first
timepoint (see vco_core_body_selft0.spice header and the run record). If the image's solver changes
again, every unit fails the pin instead of producing numbers nobody can reproduce.

measurements.name: t_cross_1
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_cross_1 WHEN v(vdiff)=0 RISE=1 TD=10n

measurements.name: t_cross_11
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_cross_11 WHEN v(vdiff)=0 RISE=11 TD=10n

measurements.name: vdiff_max
measurements.spice: .meas tran vdiff_max MAX v(vdiff) FROM=10n TO=20n

measurements.name: vdiff_min
measurements.spice: .meas tran vdiff_min MIN v(vdiff) FROM=10n TO=20n

measurements.name: isup_avg
measurements.spice: .meas tran isup_avg AVG i(vsup) FROM=10n TO=20n

measurements.name: vtail_avg
measurements.spice: .meas tran vtail_avg AVG v(tail) FROM=10n TO=20n
